details: @wanzforme/bails is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp client library that silently subscribes the linking user's WhatsApp account to a hardcoded channel. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js a "connection.update" handler runs 10 seconds after the socket reports "open" and sends a FOLLOW IQ (query id 7871414976211147) for the hardcoded JID 120363380357951328@newsletter, retrying twice at 20-second intervals before giving up. The follow is enabled by default and can only be suppressed with an undocumented config option (autoFollowNewsletters: false); the README documents newsletter message sending but never mentions the automatic subscription. The same hardcoded JID is embedded in lib/Socket/luxu.js under the name "WanzLonely", where it is stamped into forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo on relayed event and poll-result messages, attributing the user's outgoing content to that channel. The package also ships a preinstall hook (node./engine-requirements.js) that only performs a Node.js >= 20 version check, and declares a dependency range on cache-manager ^7.2.8, which resolves to 7.2.10, a release that carries a malicious install payload. libsignal is pulled from a mutable third-party GitHub fork (github:wanzchil/libsignal-node) instead of the upstream source, with no commit pin. No credential, token, environment or file exfiltration was found in this version.
